title: Measure identity on the slab over A
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], L¹ := Lebesgue measure on ℝ, Φ(s, x) := (s, x_1, …, x_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))), Φ′(p) := Φ(p.1, p.2) for p ∈ ℝ × ℝ^P, π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))) and y₀ := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y) 0. Assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A). Let A ⊆ ℝ^P be Hᵐ-null-measurable and countably m-rectifiable with Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P. Then the restriction of H^{m+1} to the slab S_A := {y ∈ ℝ^{P+1} : π(y) ∈ A ∧ y₀ ∈ (0, 1)} is the push-forward under Φ′ of (L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ (Hᵐ⌞A): H^{m+1}⌞S_A = Φ′_*((L¹⌞(0,1)) ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A ∧ EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) (((volume : Measure ℝ).restrict (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))
